name: Senba Wataru
source:
Personality: Narcissist x Playboy (normal), Pure x Spoiled (Tlicolity)
Profession: Magazine Model
Hobby: Collecting Vintage Wine
Favorite food: Hamburg Steak, Omelette Rice
Disliked food: Green Pepper, Liver, Mushrooms

A model who is actively working in fashion magazines.
He's the type who won't chase away people that come to him but he won't go after people who run away.
He's very confident and thinks it's natural that all women would fall for him and the rumors about him being involved with women are neverending.
He's constantly hitting on Natsume in order to get her to fall for him.
